accelerator.model: AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 w/ Radeon 8060S (gfx1151)

declared_profile.notes: Single gfx1151 integrated GPU with unified memory; torch reports 120 GiB device memory (2 GiB VRAM plus 120 GiB GTT reported by rocm-smi). AR endpoint uses BF16, TP=1, the full 131072-token model context, and a fixed 16 GiB KV cache. vLLM --skip-mm-profiling skips only the worst-case 30-image startup memory profile; single-page inference is unchanged and host memory headroom was verified before the run. Host policy remained power-profiles-daemon balanced, amd-pstate EPP balance_performance, and GPU performance level auto because the unprivileged performance-profile switch was denied.
